title: HPE reports Q4 revenue up 50% YoY to $14.5B, vs. $14.3B est., forecasts Q1 revenue above the average estimates but below the highest; HPE drops 6%+ after hours (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
summary: Dina Bass / Bloomberg: HPE reports Q4 revenue up 50% YoY to $14.5B, vs. $14.3B est., forecasts Q1 revenue above the average estimates but below the highest; HPE drops 6%+ after hours — Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. gave a revenue forecast for the current quarter that fell short of the most optimistic estimates …
